raw_statement: Description of event: Around 2:15 PM today (Sept 22, 2026), I was slowly reversing out of a stall in the Costco parking lot on 4th Ave South in Seattle. My car is a 2024 Toyota RAV4 XLE (gray, plate WA-BNK-3341, VIN 2T3P1RFV3RW284619, currently at 11,800 miles). At the exact same time, a dark gray Hyundai Tucson across the aisle started reversing too. Neither of us honked or saw each other until our rear bumpers tapped together at maybe 3 to 4 miles an hour. We stopped immediately. My plastic rear bumper cover has a fist-sized depression and paint transfer/scuffing, plus a hairline crack near the outer left curve. The left parking sensor looks recessed and now gives a continuous warning beep when I put the car in reverse. The other driver is Robert C. Kim, driving a 2023 Tucson (plate WA-FHL-9917, GEICO policy GK-4471-WA-889). We agreed it was mutual and low speed, so we just traded phone numbers and insurance cards. No police were called since it's private property and very minor. Absolutely no injuries to anyone. Car runs and drives fine.
